verdicts.why: In The Team, Lincoln captures Malick, Coulson persuades him at the Playground to betray Hydra and give up its bases, and Daisy, sent by Hive, kills him in his cell in the same episode.
Yondu hesitates over handing over Quill, not Groot, which sets off Taserface's mutiny. Groot fetches the wrong items several times before Kraglin gets the fin and helps free Yondu and Rocket.

Topher follows Molly to the hostel in S2E3 (#13). Molly's hope that he is family and Nico's discovery of his Gibborim vial are both in S2E4 (#14), so the stage holds in full at #14, and Nico, not Molly, is the one who exposes the lie.

Jeri cuts the shock wires and goes to open the cell but stops when she hears footsteps. Kilgrave gets out in the chaos after his mother's death, then controls Jeri at her car and later sets Wendy on her.
Wikipedia notes that the on-screen text spells the name Johnathon Ohnn, not the comics' Jonathan.
At the Oui, Anitolov pulls out Hope's seat to make her sit for Burch's deal. He shoots at her only after she attacks in the Wasp suit. No source has him pulling a gun on her when she is exposed.
The film never shows Goose arriving on Earth with Mar-Vell. Goose is Lawson's pet on Earth, and the tie-in book has the two meeting there.

Ivanov's men capture Fitz at the Krasnoyarsk base and Aida plugs him into the Framework (S4E14). Radcliffe is horrified to learn of it, so he does not kidnap Fitz. Radcliffe and Aida make the other LMDs without Fitz.
In episode 1, Take Me Home, Ronnie talks with her friends about Riri, and Madeline suspects Natalie's and Gary's deaths still haunt her. Episode 4 is about the cloak fragment.

Piper suggests turning off the cloak to keep the Framework powered. Prince/Davis objects, and Yo-Yo follows Piper's suggestion. The idea of landing to refuel was Davis's, and Piper rejected it, so there is no Piper and Yo-Yo argument about refueling.

value.text: Gargan leads the Scorpions against the 110th Street Gang and tries to impale Lonnie with his tail. Lonnie, newly super strong, fights him beside Spider-Man, then stops Spider-Man from killing him.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The rival gang boss who tries to impale Lonnie with his tail.

verdicts.why: Episode 9 has Gargan try to impale Lonnie, who catches the tail with his new Diox-3 strength, fights beside Spider-Man and then stops him. Gargan never stabs Lonnie, not in episode 5 either, where the police break up the fight, so Lonnie's card line also has to drop 'stabbed'.
Steve crashes the Valkyrie and goes missing while Morita is on the radio, before the war ends, so Morita cannot fight with him until the war's end.
Shockley orders Bynum to assassinate Simmons in S4E9, Broken Promises, after Bynum reports that she saved Vijay and came asking questions at Nadeer's office. Shockley becomes Inhuman only in S4E13.
In S4E13, BOOM, Terrigen meant for Nadeer transforms Shockley, he explodes and reforms, and Fitz and Simmons contain him in a specially made device.
Mace is Director from S4E1, The Ghost, where he pulls Mack and Coulson off the pursuit of Daisy. By S4E10 he is holding a press conference for Daisy, so the 'bring in Daisy' clause is wrong there.
In S4E10, The Patriot, the Quinjet goes down in Freyer National Park, and Coulson and Mack fight off the ex-Hydra mercenaries the Watchdogs hired.
In S2E6, Requiem, CIA operatives attack Jessica's house, and she tells Daredevil she told Mr. Charles to back off when he tried to recruit her. E7 is her later confrontation with him.

value.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2#8
value.text: In the end Sheila breaks with Fisk, bringing him the offer to leave the city in exchange for not being prosecuted.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Sheila's boss, whom she turns on by bringing him the offer to leave the city.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Fisk's chief of staff, who turns on him by bringing him the offer to leave the city.

split.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
split.text: With Fisk gone from New York, Sheila takes over as the city's mayor.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Sheila's former boss, whom she succeeds as mayor.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Fisk's former chief of staff, who succeeds him as mayor.

verdicts.why: Sheila turns on Fisk only in S2E8, when she brings him the exile offer. The finale's only scene of her as interim mayor was cut, and the wiki cites her mayoralty to Spider-Man: Brand New Day, so that fact is split onto that title.

In S3E3, No Good Deed, the FBI moves Fisk from prison to the hotel and Karen starts investigating the hotel's sale. The Wesley taunt is in E8 and the Dex attack in E10, both carried by separate entries.
In S3E8, Upstairs/Downstairs, Karen confronts Fisk and reveals that she killed Wesley.
